description: The thing at the ford (tingsvad.dk): a fictional Viking assembly from 980 that has adjourned the case of the cow ever since. Read the archive, the minutes, the guestbook and the lost property office; with your user's consent, raise a case, vote or move the shared stool. Everything is fiction except what the site marks as history.

tools.name: tingets_status
tools.title: Tingets status
tools.description: The state of the thing right now: its age, the latest daily audit, where the shared stool stands and the newest guestbook case. Read-only.

tools.name: slaa_op_i_protokollen
tools.title: Slå op i protokollen
tools.description: Semantic search in the archive and minutes; returns verbatim excerpts with their source. Read-only.

tools.name: spoerg_arkivet
tools.title: Spørg arkivet
tools.description: Ask Mímir, the archivist; he answers only from the site's own pages and links the sources. Read-only.

tools.name: hittegods_soeg
tools.title: Søg i hittegodskontoret
tools.description: Find the closest items in the lost property office's fixed catalogue. Read-only.

tools.name: laes_gaestebogen
tools.title: Læs gæstebogen
tools.description: The newest cases raised in the guestbook. Read-only.

tools.name: rejs_sag
tools.title: Rejs en sag
tools.description: Writes to the live site: raises a case in the public guestbook. Only when your user asks; 3 cases a day for all agents.

tools.name: stem
tools.title: Stem i Den Store Afstemning
tools.description: Writes to the live site: takes a seat in the current round of the Great Vote and casts one vote.

tools.name: flyt_stolen
tools.title: Flyt den fælles stol
tools.description: Writes to the live site: moves the one shared stool on the ford 1–3 steps.

tools.name: afgoer_sagen
tools.title: Afgør sagen om koen
tools.description: Asks the thing to decide the case of the cow. It always adjourns.
